purpose: Test whether short carry or a specified benchmark role can resolve the valuation-to-position gap. These are scenarios, not actual financing quotes or demonstrated alpha.
cover_values: Unchanged flat12 and risk-maturation central cases; no new operating scenario.
formula: Gross short strategy PnL per initial share = P0*(1+q)^T - P_end. q is a hypothetical all-in constant net earnings rate on the original proceeds, after stock-loan fees and program spreads; it is not observed or broker-accurate.
limits: Actual borrow fee base is marked collateral and differs from credited proceeds; fixed-net-yield compounding is only a transparent aggregate scenario.
No return on user capital or margin financing is claimed.
No dividend is assumed, consistent with cash-retention model. Future dividends require jointly reducing retained cash in endpoint value.
Initial margin capital benchmark opportunity cost must be deducted separately to claim excess account return.
No implied carry rate is substituted for operating discount rate.
Long-short expected alpha requires an explicit matched hedge, factor exposures and future benchmark returns; absent these, do not claim alpha.
